audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3 is given to Dr. Mundo in both layers, but content whys[2] ('Level 3 she still out-pokes you'), spikes[0] ('you tip favored at 4'), early ('Neeko controls levels 1-3') and the packet chart all say Neeko.
audit.why: Four of five sources agree Neeko owns Level 3; only the two chart rows disagreed with their own explanatory text.
audit.corrected: Level 3 flipped to Neeko at 4/10 in the full layer and win[2] in the content layer, with phases[2].why rewritten to state why.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] is rated Neeko 3/10 but its text reads 'Maximum Dosage makes you nearly unkillable... the lane flips to walk at him' — the row argues the opposite of its own rating.
audit.why: Level 6 belongs to Neeko because Pop Blossom (120/105/90) plus a jungler kills Mundo before his regen matters. The rating was right; the prose was boilerplate from another matchup.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten around Pop Blossom's hidden wind-up and holding R for it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions were absent from every field: Mundo's passive versus Tangle-Barbs, Pop Blossom's hidden preparation, and how Tangle-Barbs and Blooming Burst grow off the wave.
audit.why: Mundo's passive resists the first Immobilizing effect and drops a cannister he heals off — Tangle-Barbs is Neeko's only lane root, so the passive is a hard answer to it and the cooldown of that passive, not the root, is the real timer. Pop Blossom's preparation is explicitly hidden while Neeko is disguised (Inherent Glamour), so the usual visual tell does not exist. Tangle-Barbs becomes larger, faster and roots longer if it kills an enemy or passes through a champion, and Blooming Burst blooms again on killing units — both mean standing behind a dying wave doubles what hits you.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[3].why, phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, tradeBad and spikes[1].text with real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere — 'Track Neeko's Tangle-Barbs' with nothing to track.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10 and Pop Blossom 120/105/90. Those turn 'wait for it' into a countable window.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, phases[3].why and spikes[1].text.

edits.before: Cleaver-slow on cooldown now: each Q that lands refunds HP and sets up the slow walk-down. Don't force anything.
edits.after: Still hers: Blooming Burst blooms twice inside a wave and every cleaver you throw costs your own HP. Last-hit and heal up.

edits.before: Your sustain starts beating his chip. Track Tangle-Barbs and take the trades it can't answer; you regen, he doesn't.
edits.after: Your sustain beats her chip. Tangle-Barbs is 12s at rank 1 — step up in that gap, and your passive eats the first root anyway.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage makes you nearly unkillable in long fights. The lane flips from 'survive' to 'walk at him' the moment you hit 6.
edits.after: Pop Blossom's wind-up is hidden while she is disguised, and the stun plus a jungler kills you before your R regen ticks. Hold R for it.

edits.before: Fighting inside his burst window pre-6 with no passive canister on the ground — that's the only way Mundo dies in lane.
edits.after: Fighting her burst window with your passive already spent on Tangle-Barbs — that's the only way Mundo dies in this lane.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs: matchup-defining — Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your engage/committal tool: never waste it on chip damage. - Your ultimate: the win condition — spend it on kill windows, not on waves.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs (12s at rank 1): her root, and it grows if it kills a minion first — never stand behind a dying wave. - Pop Blossom (120s at rank 1): the wind-up is invisible while she is disguised. - Your R: the win condition — kill windows, never waves.

edits.before: Track Neeko's Tangle-Barbs: Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. When it is down — Cleaver-slow + run him down.
edits.after: Track Tangle-Barbs (12s at rank 1): her root. Your passive eats the first one — then walk her down while it recharges.

edits.before: Her Pop Blossom (R) is a huge burst-and-stun ultimate that, if she lands it with a jungler, deletes you before your R heal ticks up — she wants that setup, so it swings back to her at 6.
edits.after: Pop Blossom (R) knocks up then stuns, and the wind-up is hidden while her disguise is on — with a jungler it deletes you before Maximum Dosage ticks. It's 120s at rank 1: count it down.

notes: The packet's suspectNames hit on 'Her Pop Blossom' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Pop Blossom is the correct name of Neeko's R. The full layer refers to Neeko as 'he/him' in several fields (tradeGood, breakdown.trading, dosFull[1].d, report[3].t, breakdown.carry); I fixed the ones I was already editing but the rest are cosmetic and left alone rather than burning length-band edits on pronouns.
